notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-1.99.0.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Nut "Xuat BIM Viewer" xuat mo hinh ra 1 file .hpv, mo trang https://hpcons-bim-viewer.vercel.app roi KEO THA file vao trang de xem (tuong tu Autodesk Viewer: xoay, do, cat, explode, cay mo hinh, thuoc tinh, xem sheet 2D). KHONG can xuat IFC. File .hpv KHONG bi tai len may chu: trang web chi doc file ngay tren may cua ban. - Hop thoai: chon view 3D (hinh hoc lay dung an/hien + section box cua view), muc chi tiet Thap / Trung binh / Cao, tick cac sheet can xuat PDF (mac dinh chon het), noi luu file (mac dinh canh file .rvt).
